thread:
maria: Heads-up — vendor sent a partial packing list for the APAC on‑prem racks we scheduled for pickup next Wed. Missing a few serial numbers and customs docs. Anyone already tracking?
jon: I pulled the manifest they uploaded to their portal. 3 rack chassis have blank serial fields. Pinged vendor for the full CSV. :eyes:
sahil: Do we have a customs broker assigned for this shipment? cc @karen
karen: Yes — GlobalBroker is on the account. I'm waiting for the proforma/invoice from the vendor. Ask them to include HS codes and a clear commercial value.
maria: Also important: NIC firmware — we prefer NIC `2.1.4` to avoid RDMA kernel mismatches. If vendor wants to preflash, we need the image + SSH key. Otherwise ask them to leave devices stock.
dave: I can do firmware verification in staging when racks arrive. Need serial->rack mapping in advance so I can label and map MACs.
jon: Vendor replied: missing serials will be available EOD tomorrow. Pickup ETA still Wed 08:00 SGT. They offered to preflash BIOS if we provide the image and a temporary SSH key.
sahil: Prefer not to let them preflash. Request: (1) do NOT change BIOS settings, (2) keep at least one unit per rack powered off for hardware inspection.
maria: Also add the procurement id to the vendor portal so shipping labels include it. proc id is:
```
RINF-APAC-Q3-042
```
jon: Done — I added the proc id and updated the customs value. @karen can you confirm the broker gets the AWB and proforma by EOD Mon?
karen: On it. I'll upload AWB + proforma to the shared folder and confirm once broker has docs. Link will be in the procurement tracker.
vendor-rep: Confirmed — we'll push the remaining serials CSV by 18:00 SGT tomorrow and keep pickup at Wed 08:00 SGT. Will not alter BIOS unless explicitly asked.
dave: One more ask from infra: plan a 2hr maintenance window for initial smoke + firmware verification. Tentative: Thu 01:00–03:00 UTC. Is that OK for everyone?
sahil: That window works. Can we reserve 4xA100 from demo pool for validation week? cc @jon
jon: Reserved 4xA100 from demo-pool for Thu–Fri validation. Notified infra-allocations team.
maria: Perfect. If vendor posts serials or updates timing, drop them here and I'll update the procurement tracker and deployment checklist.
jon: Will do. Also leaving a short checklist for pickup ops:
- confirm serial CSV matches packing list
- confirm AWB number is printed on labels
- broker has proforma + HS codes
- one unit per rack left powered off
- firmware notes attached to manifest

maria: Thanks — team, please flag any blockers ASAP. :pray:
